translations.web: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
translations.bsb: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
translations.kjv: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
translations.asv: And the sea-coast shall be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.
